changes.text: Register and sign in as an organizer; new accounts are activated after approval or through an invite
Dashboard listing your tournaments with their status and team count
Interface available in German and English
Create and edit tournaments
Add, edit and remove teams and players while the tournament is in setup
Give each team a private access link that you can reveal, rotate or revoke
Teams sign in with their access link and see their team overview
Start a tournament; the first round's tables are drawn automatically
Rounds view showing which teams play at which table
Teams enter their own game scores
Rounds view shows each game's status and the entered scores
Tournament page split into tabs; team screens optimized for phones
Teams get a confirmation after saving a game
The scoring link on the team overview only appears while the tournament is running
Account menu behind your avatar; language picker as a flag dropdown
New light theme
Odd team counts are seated with a table of three teams
Teams confirm or retract their table's results from the team overview
Choose between light, dark and system theme
Set the total number of rounds, adjustable while the tournament is running
Standings tab and a progress card showing the current round and completed tables
Rounds view shows whether each table has confirmed its results
Tables are labelled by letter instead of number
A table's games are shown as a results table with Victory Points totals
Grand Tichu bonus is a tournament setting of 100 or 200
A double win is no longer rejected when the team's second player is entered as finishing first
Back links across the admin screens and a more compact team overview
Start the next round from the progress card once every table is complete; teams are paired by standings, avoiding rematches
Double win bonus is a tournament setting of 100 or 200
Sign in directly from the header; the admin tab is hidden from visitors
This changelog
Finish the tournament after its last round, then publish the results; the Standings tab becomes the Final Ranking
Teams keep access to their games after the tournament ends, read-only, and see the Final Ranking once you publish it
Each change in this changelog is marked as a feature, improvement or fix
While a tournament is running, games entered and tables confirmed by teams appear on your tournament page right away, and a Live badge shows the page is up to date
The tournament page updates right away when a round starts, the total rounds change or the tournament finishes, also in other open tabs, instead of every 30 seconds
Teams see the other team's games, confirmations, new rounds and the published results right away, with a Live badge on their pages, instead of every 15 to 30 seconds
Make a tournament public and switch its public visibility on or off at any time with the Public Visibility toggle on the tournament page
A public home page lists the public tournaments, grouped by status, so spectators can find them without signing in
Spectators can open a public tournament from the public home and follow every round's pairings: each table with its teams and their players
Once you publish the results, spectators see the Final Ranking and each team's summed Victory Points and Tichu Points per table on the public tournament page
Spectators see new rounds, the finish and the published results on the public tournament page right away, with a Live badge, without reloading the page
A Statistics tab on the tournament page shows each team's successful Tichu calls, bombs and double wins, the leading teams, and a chart of every team's Victory Points round by round
Once you publish the results of a public tournament, spectators find the statistics in a Statistics tab on the public tournament page
